package spotify

// ddsonic composed stage, STOCK adapter (M3B2-S3, plan v9 §4.3; D9 of §2.7):
// the stock-stage implementations of the shared core's stage hooks, and D9.
// rc.4 has no recovery decision or detach hooks, no recoveryTimeout and no
// serviceAccessPoint seam (§4.3, "absent"), so nothing is installed or
// observed there; stock probes do not use those points. Overlaid only in the
// stock stage, as external/spotify/zz_ddsonic_composed_stock_adapter_test.go
// (the composed file prefix, so Q's creator rule covers this file; it starts
// no goroutine).

import (
	"context"
	"sync"

	librespot "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot"
	"github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/session"
)

// installStageRecoveryHooks installs nothing at rc.4.
func (h *composedHarness) installStageRecoveryHooks() {}

// installStageService installs nothing at rc.4.
func (h *composedHarness) installStageService() {}

// stockD9Format is the stock key provider's own warning for an answer that
// finds no live request (v0.9.1 audio/provider.go:77). Only this exact
// format is counted: the mercury client logs "received mercury response with
// invalid sequence: %d" through the same opts.Log, and it is not counted.
const stockD9Format = "received aes key with invalid sequence: %d"

// stockD9 is D9 (plan v9 §2.7: "a counting logger in opts.Log ...
// observation ... the stock adapter only ... invalid-sequence warnings (M3a3
// S7's method)"). It records, in the order the provider's pump logged them,
// the sequence of every stock key-provider warning, and how many SDK
// constructors it wrapped. It never changes what a logger does: every call
// is passed on unchanged.
type stockD9 struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	wrapped int
	seqs    []uint32
}

// Wrapped is how many constructor calls had their opts.Log wrapped.
func (d *stockD9) Wrapped() int {
	d.mu.Lock()
	defer d.mu.Unlock()
	return d.wrapped
}

// Seqs is the warned sequences, in the order the pump logged them.
func (d *stockD9) Seqs() []uint32 {
	d.mu.Lock()
	defer d.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]uint32(nil), d.seqs...)
}

// CountSeq is how many warnings named seq.
func (d *stockD9) CountSeq(seq uint32) int {
	d.mu.Lock()
	defer d.mu.Unlock()
	n := 0
	for _, s := range d.seqs {
		if s == seq {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// stockD9Log passes every call to the logger it wraps, and records the
// stock provider's invalid-sequence warning (stockD9Format, one uint32
// argument) before passing it on. Loggers derived from it record too.
type stockD9Log struct {
	librespot.Logger
	d *stockD9
}

func (l *stockD9Log) Warnf(format string, args ...interface{}) {
	if format == stockD9Format && len(args) == 1 {
		if seq, ok := args[0].(uint32); ok {
			l.d.mu.Lock()
			l.d.seqs = append(l.d.seqs, seq)
			l.d.mu.Unlock()
		}
	}
	l.Logger.Warnf(format, args...)
}

func (l *stockD9Log) WithField(key string, value interface{}) librespot.Logger {
	return &stockD9Log{Logger: l.Logger.WithField(key, value), d: l.d}
}

func (l *stockD9Log) WithError(err error) librespot.Logger {
	return &stockD9Log{Logger: l.Logger.WithError(err), d: l.d}
}

// installStockD9 wraps the installed D1 (H's counted bypass call) so that
// every SDK constructor gets its opts.Log wrapped by D9 (v0.9.1 hands
// opts.Log to NewAudioKeyProvider, session/session.go:209). It is a write of
// a shared seam, so it is made under W1's condition: it must be the stock
// probe's first action, before any constructor (D1 = 0) and before the test
// starts any goroutine that could read the seam. It is restored through
// restoreSeams: the closure is appended after installSeams' own, so at T10
// (W2, the success path only) it runs first and puts H's D1 back, and H's
// closure then restores the product's. Branch F restores nothing, as for
// every seam.
func (h *composedHarness) installStockD9() *stockD9 {
	t := h.t
	t.Helper()
	if d1, _, _, _, _, _ := h.Counts(); d1 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("I11-PRECONDITION-FAIL: D9 must be installed before any constructor (D1 = %d)", d1)
	}
	d := &stockD9{}
	inner := newLibrespotSession
	newLibrespotSession = func(ctx context.Context, opts *session.Options) (*session.Session, error) {
		if opts != nil {
			base := opts.Log
			if base == nil {
				base = &librespot.NullLogger{}
			}
			opts.Log = &stockD9Log{Logger: base, d: d}
			d.mu.Lock()
			d.wrapped++
			d.mu.Unlock()
		}
		return inner(ctx, opts)
	}
	h.restoreSeams = append(h.restoreSeams, func() { newLibrespotSession = inner })
	h.Event("d9-installed")
	return d
}
